### Pure XML declarative configuration with tx:advice

Source: https://github.com/taketoday/today-infrastructure/blob/master/infra-docs/modules/ROOT/pages/data-access/transaction/declarative/applying-more-than-just-tx-advice.adoc

Creates the same setup as the previous example but uses pure XML declarative approach with <tx:advice> and <aop:advisor> instead of <tx:annotation-driven>. The transaction advice is ordered after the profiling aspect.

```xml
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<beans xmlns="http://www.springframework.org/schema/beans"
  xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
  xmlns:aop="http://www.springframework.org/schema/aop"
  xmlns:tx="http://www.springframework.org/schema/tx"
  xsi:schemaLocation="
    http://www.springframework.org/schema/beans
    https://www.springframework.org/schema/beans/spring-beans.xsd
    http://www.springframework.org/schema/tx
    https://www.springframework.org/schema/tx/spring-tx.xsd
    http://www.springframework.org/schema/aop
    https://www.springframework.org/schema/aop/spring-aop.xsd">

  <bean id="fooService" class="x.y.service.DefaultFooService"/>

  <!-- 性能分析通知 -->
  <bean id="profiler" class="x.y.SimpleProfiler">
    <!-- 在事务通知之前运行（因此顺序号较低） -->
    <property name="order" value="1"/>
  </bean>

  <aop:config>
    <aop:pointcut id="entryPointMethod" expression="execution(* x.y..*Service.*(..))"/>
    <!-- 在性能分析通知之后运行（参见 order 属性） -->

    <aop:advisor advice-ref="txAdvice" pointcut-ref="entryPointMethod" order="2"/>
    <!-- 顺序值高于性能分析切面 -->

    <aop:aspect id="profilingAspect" ref="profiler">
      <aop:pointcut id="serviceMethodWithReturnValue"
          expression="execution(!void x.y..*Service.*(..))"/>
      <aop:around method="profile" pointcut-ref="serviceMethodWithReturnValue"/>
    </aop:aspect>

  </aop:config>

  <tx:advice id="txAdvice" transaction-manager="txManager">
    <tx:attributes>
      <tx:method name="get*" read-only="true"/>
      <tx:method name="*"/>
    </tx:attributes>
  </tx:advice>

  <!-- 其他 <bean/> 定义，如 DataSource 和 TransactionManager 在这里 -->

</beans>
```

--------------------------------

### Minimal HTTP application with @InfraApplication and @RestController

Source: https://github.com/taketoday/today-infrastructure/blob/master/README.md

Create a minimal HTTP interface in src/main/java/example/DemoApplication.java. Uses infra-starter-webmvc and infra-starter-netty-server, requires JDK 17+. The @InfraApplication enables component scanning and auto-configuration; @GET maps GET requests to the method.

```java
package example;

import infra.app.Application;
import infra.app.InfraApplication;
import infra.web.annotation.GET;
import infra.web.annotation.RestController;

@RestController
@InfraApplication
public class DemoApplication {

  public static void main(String[] args) {
    Application.run(DemoApplication.class, args);
  }

  @GET("/hello")
  public String hello() {
    return "Hello, TODAY!";
  }
}
```

my.service.enabled=true
my.service.security.username=admin
```

### 传递系统属性：systemProperty 'com.example.property', findProperty('example') ?: 'default'

Source: https://github.com/taketoday/today-infrastructure/blob/master/infra-docs/modules/gradle-plugin/pages/running.adoc

在构建脚本中指定系统属性，传递给应用的 JVM。使用 findProperty 获取可选项目属性，并通过 ?: Elvis 运算符提供默认值。

```groovy
tasks.named("infraRun") {
  systemProperty 'com.example.property', findProperty('example') ?: 'default'
}
```

### Log output of declarative transaction example

Source: https://github.com/taketoday/today-infrastructure/blob/master/infra-docs/modules/ROOT/pages/data-access/transaction/declarative/first-example.adoc

Shows the expected logging output when running the imperative transaction example. The output is truncated for clarity; it includes proxy creation, transaction start, rollback on UnsupportedOperationException, and the exception stack trace.

```logging
	<!-- Infra 容器正在启动... -->

	<!-- 事务通知在此处生效... -->
	[DataSourceTransactionManager] - Creating new transaction with name [x.y.service.FooService.insertFoo]
	[DataSourceTransactionManager] - Acquired Connection [org.apache.commons.dbcp.PoolableConnection@a53de4] for JDBC transaction

	<!-- DefaultFooService 的 insertFoo(..) 方法抛出一个异常... -->
	[RuleBasedTransactionAttribute] - Applying rules to determine whether transaction should rollback on java.lang.UnsupportedOperationException
	[TransactionInterceptor] - Invoking rollback for transaction on x.y.service.FooService.insertFoo due to throwable [java.lang.UnsupportedOperationException]

	<!-- 事务回滚（默认情况下，RuntimeException 实例导致回滚） -->
	[DataSourceTransactionManager] - Rolling back JDBC transaction on Connection [org.apache.commons.dbcp.PoolableConnection@a53de4]
	[DataSourceTransactionManager] - Releasing JDBC Connection after transaction

	Exception in thread "main" java.lang.UnsupportedOperationException at x.y.service.DefaultFooService.insertFoo(DefaultFooService.java:14)
	<!-- 为清晰起见，删除了 AOP 基础设施堆栈跟踪元素 -->
	at $Proxy0.insertFoo(Unknown Source)
	at Boot.main(Boot.java:11)

### Get ExchangeResult for MockMvc assertions

Source: https://github.com/taketoday/today-infrastructure/blob/master/infra-docs/modules/ROOT/pages/testing/webtestclient.adoc

When using MockMvc server setup, you can obtain an ExchangeResult after asserting the body to perform further server-side assertions. The example shows both a response with a body (Person) and one without (Void).

```java
// 对于带有体的响应
EntityExchangeResult<Person> result = client.get().uri("/persons/1")
    .exchange()
    .expectStatus().isOk()
    .expectBody(Person.class)
    .returnResult();

// 对于没有体的响应
EntityExchangeResult<Void> result = client.get().uri("/path")
    .exchange()
    .expectBody().isEmpty();
```

```bash
git clone https://github.com/TAKETODAY/today-infrastructure.git
cd today-infrastructure/infra-samples
./gradlew infraRun --args='--server.port=8080'
```

### 创建 DemoApplication.java

Source: https://github.com/taketoday/today-infrastructure/blob/master/infra-docs/modules/tutorial/pages/first-application/index.adoc

在 `build.gradle` 同级目录下创建 `src/main/java/demo/DemoApplication.java`。使用 `@RestController` 和 `@InfraApplication` 注解，`main` 方法调用 `Application.run` 启动应用，`hello` 方法返回 "Hello World!"。

```java
package demo;

import infra.app.Application;
import infra.app.InfraApplication;
import infra.web.annotation.RestController;
import infra.web.annotation.GET;

@RestController
@InfraApplication
public class DemoApplication {

  public static void main(String[] args) {
    Application.run(DemoApplication.class, args);
  }

  @GET
  public String hello() {
    return "Hello World!";
  }

}
```

### TestTransaction flagForCommit and end example

Source: https://github.com/taketoday/today-infrastructure/blob/master/infra-docs/modules/ROOT/pages/testing/testcontext-framework/tx.adoc

Shows how to commit a transaction explicitly using TestTransaction.flagForCommit() and end(), then start a new transaction that will be rolled back automatically after the test.

```java
    // 对数据库的更改将被提交！
    TestTransaction.flagForCommit();
    TestTransaction.end();
    assertFalse(TestTransaction.isActive());
    assertNumUsers(0);

    TestTransaction.start();
    // 针对数据库执行其他操作，这些操作将在测试完成后自动回滚...
  }

  protected void assertNumUsers(int expected) {
    assertEquals("Number of rows in the [user] table.", expected, countRowsInTable("user"));
  }
}
```

--------------------------------

### Startup Step Instrumentation with ApplicationStartup

Source: https://github.com/taketoday/today-infrastructure/blob/master/infra-docs/modules/ROOT/pages/core/beans/context-introduction.adoc

Use ApplicationStartup to record a custom startup step during application context startup. The example shows scanning base packages with a tag. Default ApplicationStartup is a no-op; use FlightRecorderApplicationStartup for JFR tracking.

```java
// 创建启动步骤并开始记录
try (StartupStep scanPackages = getApplicationStartup().start("infra.context.base-packages.scan")) {
  // 向当前步骤添加标签信息
  scanPackages.tag("packages", () -> Arrays.toString(basePackages));
  // 执行我们要插桩的实际阶段
  this.scanner.scan(basePackages);
}
```

--------------------------------

### Test streaming responses with FluxExchangeResult

Source: https://github.com/taketoday/today-infrastructure/blob/master/infra-docs/modules/ROOT/pages/testing/webtestclient.adoc

For potentially infinite streams like text/event-stream or application/x-ndjson, first verify status and headers, then get a FluxExchangeResult. The example accepts TEXT_EVENT_STREAM and returns a FluxExchangeResult<MyEvent>.

```java
FluxExchangeResult<MyEvent> result = client.get().uri("/events")
    .accept(TEXT_EVENT_STREAM)
    .exchange()
    .expectStatus().isOk()
    .returnResult(MyEvent.class);
```

--------------------------------

### Using <util:property-path> to reference a bean property by name

Source: https://github.com/taketoday/today-infrastructure/blob/master/infra-docs/modules/ROOT/pages/core/appendix/xsd-schemas.adoc

The path attribute follows the form beanName.beanProperty. This example gets the 'age' property of bean 'testBean', which has value 10.

```xml
<!-- target bean to be referenced by name -->
<bean id="testBean" class="infra.beans.TestBean" scope="prototype">
  <property name="age" value="10"/>
  <property name="spouse">
    <bean class="infra.beans.TestBean">
      <property name="age" value="11"/>
    </bean>
  </property>
</bean>

<!-- results in 10, which is the value of property 'age' of bean 'testBean' -->
<util:property-path id="name" path="testBean.age"/>
```

### ExampleBean with @ConstructorProperties annotation

Source: https://github.com/taketoday/today-infrastructure/blob/master/infra-docs/modules/ROOT/pages/core/beans/dependencies/factory-collaborators.adoc

Example class using the JDK @ConstructorProperties annotation to explicitly name constructor parameters, allowing name-based matching without debug flags.

```java
package examples;

public class ExampleBean {

  // 字段省略

  @ConstructorProperties({"years", "ultimateAnswer"})
  public ExampleBean(int years, String ultimateAnswer) {
    this.years = years;
    this.ultimateAnswer = ultimateAnswer;
  }
}
```

### Use @ResponseBody on a controller method

Source: https://github.com/taketoday/today-infrastructure/blob/master/infra-docs/modules/ROOT/pages/web/webmvc/mvc-controller/ann-methods/responsebody.adoc

Annotate a controller method with @ResponseBody so the return value is serialized to the response body by an HttpMessageConverter. The example shows a method handling GET /accounts/{id} and returning an Account object.

```java
@GET("/accounts/{id}")
@ResponseBody
public Account handle() {
  // ...
}
```

### 创建 build.gradle 文件

Source: https://github.com/taketoday/today-infrastructure/blob/master/infra-docs/modules/tutorial/pages/first-application/index.adoc

使用 Gradle 构建时，需要创建 `build.gradle` 构建脚本。该脚本应用 `infra.application` 插件和 `io.spring.dependency-management` 插件，并添加 `infra-starter-web` 和 `infra-starter-netty` 依赖。

```groovy
plugins {
  id 'java'
  id 'infra.application' version '{infra-version}'
}

apply plugin: 'io.spring.dependency-management'  // 有了该插件可以自动导入 infra-dependencies

group = 'com.example'
version = '0.0.1-SNAPSHOT'
sourceCompatibility = '17'

repositories {
  mavenLocal()
  maven { url "https://central.sonatype.com/repository/maven-snapshots/" }
  mavenCentral()
}

dependencies {
  implementation 'cn.taketoday:infra-starter-web'   // <1>
  implementation 'cn.taketoday:infra-starter-netty' // <2>

}
```

### 使用 @ContextConfiguration 和 initializers 属性配置上下文初始化器

Source: https://github.com/taketoday/today-infrastructure/blob/master/infra-docs/modules/ROOT/pages/testing/testcontext-framework/ctx-management/initializers.adoc

在测试类上使用 @ContextConfiguration 并设置 initializers 属性，指定实现 ApplicationContextInitializer 的类。初始化器用于初始化测试加载的 ConfigurableApplicationContext，且其支持的 ConfigurableApplicationContext 类型必须与 SmartContextLoader 创建的 ApplicationContext 类型兼容。初始化器调用顺序取决于是否实现 Ordered 接口或标注 @Order 或 @Priority 注解。

```java
@ExtendWith(InfraExtension.class)
// ApplicationContext 将从 TestConfig 加载
// 并由 TestAppCtxInitializer 初始化
@ContextConfiguration(
  classes = TestConfig.class,
  initializers = TestAppCtxInitializer.class) // <1>
class MyTest {
  // 类主体...
}

```

--------------------------------

### Declare a SQL group with @SqlGroup

Source: https://github.com/taketoday/today-infrastructure/blob/master/infra-docs/modules/ROOT/pages/testing/annotations/integration-infra/annotation-sqlgroup.adoc

Use @SqlGroup to aggregate multiple @Sql annotations for a test method. The example declares two SQL scripts: one for schema setup with a custom comment prefix and one for user data. This is useful when you need to run multiple SQL scripts together for a test.

```java
@Test
@SqlGroup({ // <1>
  @Sql(scripts = "/test-schema.sql", config = @SqlConfig(commentPrefix = "`")),
  @Sql("/test-user-data.sql")
})
void userTest() {
  // 运行使用测试架构和测试数据的代码
}
```

--------------------------------

### 配置示例：使用 [configprops,yaml] 编写配置

Source: https://github.com/taketoday/today-infrastructure/blob/master/infra-docs/README.md

使用 `[configprops,yaml]` 编写配置示例，构建时会自动生成 YAML 和 Properties 两个选项卡。Properties 选项卡将嵌套对象展开为点分属性名，将列表展开为 `[0]`、`[1]` 等索引，并将多个 YAML 文档转换为使用 `#---` 分隔的 Properties 文档。YAML 原文保留；生成的 Properties 不保留 YAML 注释，空对象和空列表不生成属性。扩展目前只接受 YAML 输入，不支持自定义 YAML 标签或循环别名。

```asciidoc
[configprops,yaml]
----
infra:
  profiles:
    validate: false
----
```

### 使用 @ComponentScan 自动检测组件

Source: https://github.com/taketoday/today-infrastructure/blob/master/infra-docs/modules/ROOT/pages/core/beans/classpath-scanning.adoc

在 @Configuration 类中添加 @ComponentScan，basePackages 属性指定共同父包。也可以使用 value 属性简写，如 @ComponentScan("org.example")。

```java
@Configuration
@ComponentScan(basePackages = "org.example")
public class AppConfig  {
  // ...
}
```

### 使用 RestClient 执行 GET 请求

Source: https://github.com/taketoday/today-infrastructure/blob/master/infra-docs/modules/ROOT/pages/integration/rest-clients.adoc

演示 RestClient 的基本 GET 请求：设置方法、URI、检索响应并将响应体转换为 String。URI 变量和 Accept 头可用于 JSON 转换。

```java
String result = restClient.get()
  .uri("https://example.com")
  .retrieve()
  .body(String.class);

System.out.println(result);
```

### 通过 manifest Start-Class 属性配置主类

Source: https://github.com/taketoday/today-infrastructure/blob/master/infra-docs/modules/gradle-plugin/pages/packaging.adoc

在任务的 manifest 中配置 Start-Class 属性来指定主类。注意：如果入口代码使用 Kotlin，应使用编译后的 Java 类名，例如顶层 main 函数默认类名为文件名加 Kt 后缀。

```groovy
tasks.named("infraJar") {
  manifest {
    attributes 'Start-Class': 'com.example.ExampleApplication'
  }
}
```

--------------------------------

### build.gradle 配置

Source: https://github.com/taketoday/today-infrastructure/blob/master/infra-docs/modules/application/pages/using/non-web-applications.adoc

使用 buildscript 加载 infra-gradle-plugin 并应用 infra.application，添加基础应用 Starter。

```groovy
buildscript {
  repositories {
    mavenLocal()
    mavenCentral()
    maven { url = uri('https://central.sonatype.com/repository/maven-snapshots/') }
  }

  dependencies {
    classpath 'cn.taketoday:infra-gradle-plugin:{infra-version}'
  }
}

apply plugin: 'java'
apply plugin: 'infra.application'

group = 'com.example'
version = '0.0.1-SNAPSHOT'

java {
  toolchain {
    languageVersion = JavaLanguageVersion.of(17)
  }
}

repositories {
  mavenLocal()
  mavenCentral()
  maven { url = uri('https://central.sonatype.com/repository/maven-snapshots/') }
}

dependencies {
  implementation 'cn.taketoday:infra-starter-application'
  implementation 'cn.taketoday:infra-starter-logback'
}
```

### Boot 测试程序

Source: https://github.com/taketoday/today-infrastructure/blob/master/infra-docs/modules/ROOT/pages/data-access/transaction/declarative/first-example.adoc

加载 context.xml 配置，获取 FooService 代理并调用 insertFoo 方法以触发事务。

```java
public final class Boot {

  public static void main(final String[] args) throws Exception {
    ApplicationContext ctx = new ClassPathXmlApplicationContext("context.xml");
    FooService fooService = ctx.getBean(FooService.class);
    fooService.insertFoo(new Foo());
  }
}
```

--------------------------------

### Strongly Typed Advice Example - Service Interface and Implementation

Source: https://github.com/taketoday/today-infrastructure/blob/master/infra-docs/modules/ROOT/pages/core/aop/schema.adoc

Service interface and implementation used in a more complex XSD-based example with strongly typed advice parameters.

```java
package com.xyz.service;

public interface PersonService {

  Person getPerson(String personName, int age);
}

public class DefaultPersonService implements PersonService {

  public Person getPerson(String name, int age) {
    return new Person(name, age);
  }
}
```

### Build and run executable JAR

Source: https://github.com/taketoday/today-infrastructure/blob/master/infra-docs/modules/application/pages/using/non-web-applications.adoc

Builds an executable JAR with the application plugin and runs it with a command-line argument. The argument --cli.greeting=你好 Alice is passed to the application.

```shell
./gradlew infraJar
java -jar build/libs/hello-cli-0.0.1-SNAPSHOT.jar --cli.greeting=你好 Alice
```

### Properties: PropertyOverrideConfigurer format example

Source: https://github.com/taketoday/today-infrastructure/blob/master/infra-docs/modules/ROOT/pages/core/beans/factory-extension.adoc

Property file lines use the format beanName.property=value. This example overrides driverClassName and url for a bean named dataSource. Overridden values are always literal; they are not converted to bean references.

```properties
dataSource.driverClassName=com.mysql.jdbc.Driver
dataSource.url=jdbc:mysql:mydb
```

### Submodule build.gradle applying infra.application plugin

Source: https://github.com/taketoday/today-infrastructure/blob/master/README.md

After using either of the above configurations, submodules can apply the 'infra.application' plugin. Includes repositories and dependencies for infra-starter-netty-server and infra-starter-webmvc.

```groovy
apply plugin: "java"
apply plugin: 'infra.application'

repositories {
  mavenLocal()
  maven { url "https://central.sonatype.com/repository/maven-snapshots/" }
  maven { url "https://maven.aliyun.com/repository/public" }
  mavenCentral()
}

dependencies {
  implementation 'cn.taketoday:infra-starter-netty-server'
  implementation 'cn.taketoday:infra-starter-webmvc'
}

```

--------------------------------

### Build RouterFunction with route() and add()

Source: https://github.com/taketoday/today-infrastructure/blob/master/infra-docs/modules/ROOT/pages/web/webmvc-functional.adoc

Constructs a RouterFunction with GET, POST, and add() to combine routes. Uses RequestPredicates.accept(APPLICATION_JSON) for GET routes. The add() method includes otherRoute built elsewhere.

```java
import static infra.http.MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON;
import static infra.web.handler.function.RequestPredicates.accept;
import static infra.web.handler.function.RouterFunctions.route;

PersonRepository repository = ...
PersonHandler handler = new PersonHandler(repository);

RouterFunction<ServerResponse> otherRoute = ...

RouterFunction<ServerResponse> route = route()
  .GET("/person/{id}", accept(APPLICATION_JSON), handler::getPerson) // <1>
  .GET("/person", accept(APPLICATION_JSON), handler::listPeople) // <2>
  .POST("/person", handler::createPerson) // <3>
  .add(otherRoute) // <4>
  .build();
```

--------------------------------

### Run the previous configuration with Java application

Source: https://github.com/taketoday/today-infrastructure/blob/master/infra-docs/modules/ROOT/pages/core/beans/factory-extension.adoc

Java application that loads the XML configuration and retrieves the messenger bean. It prints the messenger to the system console.

```java
import infra.context.ApplicationContext;
import infra.context.support.ClassPathXmlApplicationContext;
import infra.scripting.Messenger;

public final class Boot {

  public static void main(final String[] args) throws Exception {
    ApplicationContext ctx = new ClassPathXmlApplicationContext("scripting/beans.xml");
    Messenger messenger = ctx.getBean("messenger", Messenger.class);
    System.out.println(messenger);
  }

}
```

### 使用 PropertiesLauncher 启动

Source: https://github.com/taketoday/today-infrastructure/blob/master/infra-docs/modules/gradle-plugin/pages/packaging.adoc

在任务的清单中设置 Main-Class 为 infra.app.loader.PropertiesLauncher，以使用 PropertiesLauncher 启动可执行 jar 或 war。

```groovy
tasks.named("infraWar") {
  manifest {
    attributes 'Main-Class': 'infra.app.loader.PropertiesLauncher'
  }
}
```

### RestClient GET with custom 4xx error handler

Source: https://github.com/taketoday/today-infrastructure/blob/master/infra-docs/modules/ROOT/pages/integration/rest-clients.adoc

Creates a GET request to a URL that returns a 404 status code and sets a status handler for all 4xx client errors, throwing a custom runtime exception with the response status and headers.

```java
String result = restClient.get() <1>
  .uri("https://example.com/this-url-does-not-exist") <1>
  .retrieve()
  .onStatus(HttpStatusCode::is4xxClientError, (request, response) -> { <2>
      throw new MyCustomRuntimeException(response.getStatusCode(), response.getHeaders()) <3>
  })
  .body(String.class);
```

使用 @RestController 和 @GET 注解定义控制器，方法返回字符串。

```java
@RestController
public class HelloController {

  @GET("/hello")
  public String handle() {
    return "Hello World!";
  }
}

### count

Source: https://github.com/taketoday/today-infrastructure/blob/master/infra-docs/modules/ROOT/pages/data-access/persistence/entity-manager.adoc

Counts entities. Supports no condition or an example object.

```APIDOC
## count

### Description
Counts entities. Supports no condition or an example object.

### Method
count

### Parameters
#### Request Body
- **example** (Object) - Optional - Example object for query conditions.

### Response
#### Success Response
- **total** (Number) - The count of entities.

### Request Example
```java
Number total = entityManager.count(User.class);
Number active = entityManager.count(User.class, example);
```
```

### 在单个 YAML 文件中使用 Profile 专用配置

Source: https://github.com/taketoday/today-infrastructure/blob/master/infra-docs/modules/application/pages/features/profiles.adoc

在单个 YAML 文件中使用 `---` 分隔文档，并使用 `app.config.activate.on-profile` 控制某段配置。

```yaml
myapp:
  endpoint: "https://test.example.com"
---
app:
  config:
    activate:
      on-profile: "production"
myapp:
  endpoint: "https://api.example.com"
```

### 克隆仓库并构建

Source: https://github.com/taketoday/today-infrastructure/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md

克隆你的 Fork 仓库，使用 Gradle Wrapper 构建项目。项目使用 JDK 25 构建，兼容 Java 17+。

```bash
# 1. 克隆你的Fork仓库
git clone https://github.com/YOUR_USERNAME/today-infrastructure.git
cd today-infrastructure

# 2. 使用项目包装器（推荐）
./gradlew build

# 3. 导入IDE
# 项目已包含Gradle配置，可直接用IntelliJ IDEA或Eclipse导入。
```

### 类级别和方法级别的 @RequestMapping 示例

Source: https://github.com/taketoday/today-infrastructure/blob/master/infra-docs/modules/ROOT/pages/web/webmvc/mvc-controller/ann-requestmapping.adoc

在类级别声明共享路径，在方法级别使用组合注解 @GET 和 @POST 指定具体端点。@RequestMapping 不能在同一元素上重复使用，否则只使用第一个映射。

```java
@RestController
@RequestMapping("/persons")
class PersonController {

  @GET("/{id}")
  public Person getPerson(@PathVariable Long id) {
    // ...
  }

  @POST
  @ResponseStatus(HttpStatus.CREATED)
  public void add(@RequestBody Person person) {
    // ...
  }
}
```

--------------------------------

### DeferredResult 异步返回值示例

Source: https://github.com/taketoday/today-infrastructure/blob/master/infra-docs/modules/ROOT/pages/web/webmvc/mvc-ann-async.adoc

控制器方法返回 DeferredResult 进入异步处理，可从其他线程设置结果。示例包含 @GET 注解的控制器方法和实现 HttpRequestHandler 的处理器，以及从其他线程调用 setResult 的代码。

```java
@GET("/quotes")
@ResponseBody
public DeferredResult<String> quotes() {
  DeferredResult<String> deferredResult = new DeferredResult<>();
  // 其他地方引用 deferredResult 变量.
  return deferredResult;
}

// 或者其他方式的处理器
public class MyHttpRequestHandler implements HttpRequestHandler {

  @Nullable
  @Override
  public DeferredResult<String> handleRequest(HttpContext request) throws Throwable {
    DeferredResult<String> deferredResult = new DeferredResult<>();
    // 其他地方引用 deferredResult 变量.
    return deferredResult;
  }

}

// 从其他线程设置返回结果...
deferredResult.setResult(result);
```

### 自定义启动脚本属性 (launchScript properties)

Source: https://github.com/taketoday/today-infrastructure/blob/master/infra-docs/modules/gradle-plugin/pages/packaging.adoc

通过 properties 属性自定义默认启动脚本的配置值。示例中设置 logFilename 为 example-app.log。

```groovy
tasks.named("infraJar") {
  launchScript {
    properties 'logFilename': 'example-app.log'
  }
}
```

--------------------------------

### XML 配置回滚规则：rollback-for 属性

Source: https://github.com/taketoday/today-infrastructure/blob/master/infra-docs/modules/ROOT/pages/data-access/transaction/declarative/rolling-back.adoc

通过 `rollback-for` 属性为已检查的、特定于应用程序的 `Exception` 类型配置回滚，使用异常模式。此示例将 `NoProductInStockException` 配置为回滚，并设置 `get*` 方法为只读。

```xml
<tx:advice id="txAdvice" transaction-manager="txManager">
  <tx:attributes>
    <tx:method name="get*" read-only="true" rollback-for="NoProductInStockException"/>
    <tx:method name="*"/>
  </tx:attributes>
</tx:advice>
```

--------------------------------

### 索引数组和集合示例

Source: https://github.com/taketoday/today-infrastructure/blob/master/infra-docs/modules/ROOT/pages/core/expressions/language-ref/properties-arrays.adoc

使用方括号获取数组或集合的第 n 个元素。对于 List 直接通过 get(n) 访问，其他 Collection 通过迭代器访问。

```java
ExpressionParser parser = new SpelExpressionParser();
EvaluationContext context = SimpleEvaluationContext.forReadOnlyDataBinding().build();

// 发明数组

// 评估结果为 "Induction motor"
String invention = parser.parseExpression("inventions[3]").getValue(
    context, tesla, String.class);

// 成员列表

// 评估结果为 "Nikola Tesla"
String name = parser.parseExpression("members[0].name").getValue(
    context, ieee, String.class);

// 列表和数组索引

// 评估结果为 "Wireless communication"
String invention = parser.parseExpression("members[0].inventions[6]").getValue(
    context, ieee, String.class);
```

### 复现性能测试（JVM 模式）

Source: https://github.com/taketoday/today-infrastructure/blob/master/README.md

克隆 today-blog 示例项目，启动应用（JVM 模式），然后运行低并发和高并发 wrk 压测命令。运行前需准备数据库、初始化数据并安装 wrk。

```bash
# 克隆示例项目
git clone https://github.com/TAKETODAY/today-blog
cd today-blog

# 启动应用（JVM 模式）
./gradlew :blog-api:infraRun

# 低并发延迟测试
wrk -t2 -c10 -d30s --latency 'http://127.0.0.1:8080/api/articles?size=1'

# 高并发吞吐测试
wrk -t20 -c5000 -d1m --latency 'http://127.0.0.1:8080/api/articles?size=1'
```

### 启用 BuildInfo 任务 (Groovy)

Source: https://github.com/taketoday/today-infrastructure/blob/master/infra-docs/modules/gradle-plugin/pages/build-info.adoc

通过插件的 DSL 配置一个名为 infraBuildInfo 的 BuildInfo 任务，并在 Java 插件的 classes 任务存在时使其依赖于该任务。生成的文件位于主源集资源输出目录下的 META-INF 目录。

```groovy
infraApplication {
  enableBuildInfo()
}
```

### 使用默认 Groovy 脚本位置

Source: https://github.com/taketoday/today-infrastructure/blob/master/infra-docs/modules/ROOT/pages/testing/testcontext-framework/ctx-management/groovy.adoc

省略 locations 和 value 属性时，TestContext 框架基于测试类名称检测默认 Groovy 脚本。例如，类 com.example.MyTest 将从 "classpath:com/example/MyTestContext.groovy" 加载。

```java
@ExtendWith(InfraExtension.class)
// ApplicationContext 将从
// "classpath:com/example/MyTestContext.groovy" 加载
@ContextConfiguration // <1>
class MyTest {
  // 类主体...
}
```

### GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}

Source: https://github.com/taketoday/today-infrastructure/blob/master/infra-docs/modules/ROOT/pages/integration/rest-clients.adoc

Retrieves a repository by owner and repository name using the @GetExchange annotation.

```APIDOC
## [GET] /repos/{owner}/{repo}

### Description
Retrieves a repository by owner and repository name using the @GetExchange annotation.

### Method
GET

### Endpoint
/repos/{owner}/{repo}

### Parameters
#### Path Parameters
- **owner** (String) - Required - The owner of the repository.
- **repo** (String) - Required - The name of the repository.

### Response
#### Success Response (200)
- **Repository** (object) - The repository details.
```

### webAppContextSetup 配置 MockMvc 使用 Infra 配置

Source: https://github.com/taketoday/today-infrastructure/blob/master/infra-docs/modules/ROOT/pages/testing/mvc-test-framework/server-setup-options.adoc

使用 MockMvcBuilders.webAppContextSetup 指向包含 Web MVC 和控制器基础设施的 Infra 配置。使用测试已加载的 Web 应用上下文，可以验证该上下文中的 MVC 配置。TestContext 框架会缓存可复用的上下文。

```java
@JUnitWebConfig(locations = "my-servlet-context.xml")
class MyWebTests {

  MockMvc mockMvc;

  @BeforeEach
  void setup(WebApplicationContext wac) {
    this.mockMvc = MockMvcBuilders.webAppContextSetup(wac).build();
  }

  // ...

}
```

### Lifecycle interface definition

Source: https://github.com/taketoday/today-infrastructure/blob/master/infra-docs/modules/ROOT/pages/core/beans/factory-nature.adoc

The Lifecycle interface defines start(), stop(), and isRunning() for objects with lifecycle needs.

```java
public interface Lifecycle {

  void start();

  void stop();

  boolean isRunning();
}
```

### 使用逗号分隔的位置组

Source: https://github.com/taketoday/today-infrastructure/blob/master/infra-docs/modules/application/pages/features/external-config.adoc

app.config.location=classpath:/cfg/,classpath:/ext/ 将两个目录划为不同组，先处理 /cfg 组全部 Profile，再处理 /ext 组。

```properties
app.config.location=classpath:/cfg/,classpath:/ext/
```

### 仅使用初始化器配置上下文（省略配置类）

Source: https://github.com/taketoday/today-infrastructure/blob/master/infra-docs/modules/ROOT/pages/testing/testcontext-framework/ctx-management/initializers.adoc

可以完全省略 @ContextConfiguration 中的 XML 配置文件、Groovy 脚本或组件类声明，仅声明 ApplicationContextInitializer 类。初始化器负责在上下文中注册 bean，例如通过编程方式从 XML 文件或配置类加载 bean 定义。

```java
@ExtendWith(InfraExtension.class)
// ApplicationContext 将由 EntireAppInitializer 初始化
// 该初始化器大概会在上下文中注册 bean
@ContextConfiguration(initializers = EntireAppInitializer.class) <1>
class MyTest {
  // 类主体...
}

```

### CliApplication with @EnableScheduling

Source: https://github.com/taketoday/today-infrastructure/blob/master/infra-docs/modules/application/pages/using/non-web-applications.adoc

Adds scheduling support to the application. The comment indicates to use the keep-alive main method from the previous example.

```java
@EnableScheduling
@InfraApplication
public class CliApplication {
  // 使用上面的常驻应用 main 方法。
}
```

### 使用分号分隔的位置组

Source: https://github.com/taketoday/today-infrastructure/blob/master/infra-docs/modules/application/pages/features/external-config.adoc

app.config.location=classpath:/cfg/;classpath:/ext/ 将两个目录放在同一组，按 Profile 顺序遍历组内位置。

```properties
app.config.location=classpath:/cfg/;classpath:/ext/
```
